title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: device status data by query instead of export (GCC, GCC High and DoD)
summary: The reporting capability, government-cloud scope, licensing and query APIs are supported by the roadmap and Microsoft documentation. Minor corrections should complete the role-configuration route, clarify the valid-user indicator and add the Worldwide roadmap citation.

claims.claim: DeviceInfo is updated continuously.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The DeviceInfo sample uses arg_max by DeviceId to obtain the latest device state.
claims.quote:
You can use the following sample query to get the latest state of a device:
DeviceInfo
| extend IngestionTime = ingestion_time()
| where DeviceName == "example" and isnotempty(OSPlatform)
| summarize arg_max(IngestionTime, *) by DeviceId

claims.claim: The Purview troubleshooting page provides remediation steps for device configuration and policy synchronization problems.
claims.quote: If the status is Not available or Not updated, follow the remediation steps in the details pane and the steps in the workflow diagram.

claims.claim: A false HasDlpValidUpn points to users outside policy scope.
claims.quote: Valid user | This indicates if the currently logged on user has a corresponding Entra ID account and is in scope of a DLP policy that's targeted at Devices.
claims.fix: Replace the final checklist bullet with: 'Watch for devices where HasDlpValidUpn is false, indicating a problem with a valid user principal name, or HasDlpACBandwidthExceeded is true, indicating that the DLP Advanced Classification bandwidth threshold has been exceeded.' The valid-user condition also includes having a corresponding Entra ID account, not just policy scope.

claims.claim: The custom-role configuration route is Permissions > Microsoft Defender XDR > Roles > Create custom role > Choose permissions > Security operations.
claims.quote:
On the Choose permissions page, select each of the following as needed to configure permissions for that area:
Security operations: Permissions for roles that manage day-to-day operations and respond to incidents and advisories.
claims.fix: Set controls[2].ui.path to 'Permissions > Microsoft Defender XDR > Roles > Create custom role > Basics > Choose permissions > Security operations > Security data > Security data basics (read)'. Add https://learn.microsoft.com/defender-xdr/custom-permissions-details to sources for the final permission. In the note, give the remaining assignment route: 'Assign users and data sources > Add assignment; select the employees and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint data source.' The printed route is correct but stops before the deciding permission and assignment.
